checks.label: static dangerous-function lead
checks.rationale: Source symbol is an explicit heuristic; invocation and overflow are not claimed.

checks.label: modeled bounded write
checks.rationale: Controlled source-to-sink model establishes a satisfiable out-of-bounds write condition.

checks.label: controlled null write
checks.rationale: Controlled diagnostic crash fixture writes through a null pointer; no exploitability is claimed.

checks.label: modeled command sink
checks.rationale: Controlled taint source reaches a modeled command sink; the command is never executed.

checks.label: explicit credential assignment
checks.rationale: Scanner assigns probable confidence only to explicit credential assignments.

checks.label: cryptographic candidate
checks.rationale: Private-key and weak-crypto pattern matches remain heuristic without usage validation.

scope: Controlled labeled samples with source/evidence rules; vendor-image calibration and independent human review remain separate.
